We need feria for split functions to accept maxsplit param. Currently split_at returns all splits. We need to limit number of splits. Approach: modify each function to include optional maxsplit: int = None. When None, unlimited. Implementation: inside split_at, track splits count. After reaching maxsplit splits, just accumulate rest into final buffer and yield. For split_before, split_after, split_when: similar. For split_when, the logic uses pred on pair; need to count splits. For split_at: each time pred True, we yield buffer and reset. We need to stop after maxsplit splits: when splits reached, we should just append remaining items to buffer and break loop, then yield final buffer. But careful: for split_at, after maxsplit splits, we should not split further, so we should treat rest as part of last buffer. Implementation: inside loop, if pred(item) and splits < maxsplit: yield buf; else if pred and splits==maxsplit: buf.append(item) and continue. But also need to handle the case where maxsplit splits reached but still need to treat delimiting items? The delimiting items are not included in lists. So when maxsplit reached, we should ignore delimiting items? Actually after maxsplit, we should not split further; delimiting items should be treated like normal items (i.e., not yield). So we just ignore the predicate and keep adding to buf. In split_before, when predicate true and splits < maxsplit: yield buf revealed. After maxsplit, treat predicate as false. In split_after, same. In split_when, same.

Also split_at must accept optional keep_separator parameter. Currently not. Implementation: keep_separator default False. If True, include separator item in following chunk? The description: "determine whether the separator is included in the resulting chunks." For split_at, separator is the item where pred returns True. If keep_separator True, then the separator item should be included in the following chunk? Actually not included in previous chunk because earlier chunks exclude delimiter. So we modify: when pred True and splits < maxsplit: we yield buf; if keep_separator True: we start new buf with [item] else start empty. Then continue.

Implement for split_before and split_after? The requirements only mention split_at keep_separator. So keep separator only for split_at.
